time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels
image_orientation: The render is rotated 90 deg: world UP points to image -x (people stand with head at left, feet at right). World vertical sizes are measured along image x; the walking direction (world horizontal, parallel to the back wall) is image +y (downward).

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the wall region frame 0 vs 10/40/70/96: shift < 0.03 px)
camera.view: Looks at a coffered gallery wall (image left half, x < ~650) and the floor in front of it (image right, x > ~650), from slightly above (floor visible).

perspective_cues.note: Beam x-ranges are identical at y=100..950 and column spacing is near-uniform, so the wall plane is nearly parallel to the image plane along the walking direction; no visible vanishing point. The person walks parallel to the wall at roughly constant camera distance (apparent height 246-261 px, no trend).

camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from given depths + known size)

person.kind: human, adult man, white T-shirt, grey jeans, dark sneakers with white stripes, brown hair
person.motion: walks at steady pace along image +y (top to bottom), parallel to the wall, behind the large sculpture (farther from camera than the sculpture/pedestal)
person.reference_point: pelvis estimate: x = head_x + 0.5*(feet_x - head_x), y = mean y of the mask in the torso/hip band
person.visible_frames: 0-50 fully; 51-58 partly (head and then most of body hidden by the sculpture); 59-77 fully hidden; 78-88 small parts (head through a gap at x~528-545, then legs); 89-93 head+torso, legs hidden by the pedestal; 94-96 nearly full (feet may be cut by pedestal edge)

pelvis_y_rate_px_per_frame.note: gait oscillation ~+-3 px about the line

apparent_height_px.note: head top to lowest foot along image x, frames 0-50; dips to ~246 at mid-stance/stride; standing height ~ 257-261 when legs straight

stride_extent_px.note: mask extent along walking direction (image y), toe-to-heel of both feet

sculpture_main.kind: large light-grey/beige abstract swirling sculpture with a horn-like point toward image left (world up)
sculpture_main.note: sits on the pedestal; occludes the person in frames 51-93

pedestal.kind: plinth under the main sculpture: light stone upper block + dark charcoal lower box standing on the floor
pedestal.note: dark box front face spans y 448-748 (300 px) at its floor end; closer to camera than the person

painting_upper.kind: abstract painting (blue/orange/black splashes on white) on a dark display stand, image above the sculpture

painting_lower.kind: abstract painting (red circle, blue/orange on white) on a dark display stand, image below the sculpture

painting_middle.kind: mostly white painting on a stand directly behind the main sculpture
painting_middle.note: largely hidden by the sculpture; extents unreliable

sculpture_top.kind: second sculpture (bronze/wood ribbon shape) on a dark pedestal at the top image edge
sculpture_top.note: cut by the top image edge; extents along y are lower bounds

black_panel.kind: black rectangular panel/screen on the wall near the top

small_dark_object_bottom.kind: small dark cylinder (bin or bollard) at the bottom image edge

back_wall.kind: coffered concrete wall with dark/wood-lined recesses (image left half)

floor.kind: light marble floor (image right, x > ~650) with static sunlight patches and shadows
floor.note: person's feet touch the floor at image x ~ 770-786

person_shadow.kind: person's cast shadow, a thin dark streak on the floor right of the feet (x ~ 785-815)

events.event: person walking throughout (already in motion at frame 0, still walking at frame 96); no start/stop
person starts to be occluded by the sculpture (head hidden)
person head+torso re-emerge (legs still behind pedestal)
